text: The raised speed hump near the bus depot has broken into loose pieces.
Station ke paas cycle lane par construction ka gravel faila hua hai.
Runoff has washed away part of the road shoulder beside the culvert; one lane remains open.
Tap water has smelled metallic in our building on three mornings this week.
मोहल्ले में पानी का टैंकर इस हफ़्ते दो बार नहीं आया।
The public standpipe handle snapped and water is running continuously onto the pavement.
The neighborhood public toilet door sticks and requires repeated effort to open.
Market ke waste compactor kaam nahi kar raha, kachra abhi bins ke andar hai.
Used medical needles are visible in an open waste bin beside the playground.
The electrical feeder cabinet at the bus shelter is open with live terminals exposed at hand height.
Voltage drop ke karan lift rukti hai, lekin staff passengers ko safely nikaal leta hai.
A power pole is leaning after its support cable snapped; no wire is on the ground.
Wastewater is bubbling from a covered inspection chamber onto a parking area.
बारिश से पहले नाली की जाली सूखे पत्तों से भर गई है।
Rainwater is ankle-deep in the pedestrian underpass, which remains open to foot traffic.
The lights on the bridge switch off before midnight even though the timer is set later.
Park ke paas light pole ka base toot gaya hai aur pole footpath ki taraf jhuk raha hai.
बस स्टॉप के पास पैदल रास्ते से स्पर्श संकेत वाली टाइलें गायब हैं।
The handrail at the public library ramp has come loose at one end.
A cracked seesaw seat in the park has been taped off until it can be repaired.
